spec2def(compstui.dll compstui.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# compstui.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/compstui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(compstui_shims OBJECT compstui_main.c)
target_link_libraries(compstui_shims PRIVATE wine msvcrtex libcomctl32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(compstui_shims)
add_cargo_module(compstui compstui-cargo compstui.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS compstui_shims psdk)
